name: com.unity.inputsystem.switch
description: Switch Devices for new Input System
author: Unity

samples.description: Sample that shows the basics of getting input from a NPad and how to assign controllers based on the outcome of the Controller Support Applet IMPORTANT: You must install the Nintendo SDK Plugin for this Sample
Sample that shows how to rebind a controller based on the style of the NPad IMPORTANT: You must install the Nintendo SDK Plugin for this Sample
Sample that used the Six-Axis sensors to move cubes in the scene IMPORTANT: You must import TMPro Essential Resources for this Sample.

_upm.changelog:
### Fixed
- Fixed the Controller Rebinding sample, which opened the Controller Support Applet when DebugPad was enabled.
- Fixed the use of AssetDatabase.ImportPackage, which is deprecated in 6000.7 and later, in the Input and Controller Support Applet and Controller Rebinding samples. In 6000.7 and later UnityEditor.AssetPackage.Package.Import will be used.
